map.：岩棉 k≈0.040 W/(m·K)、厚 0.1 m：单位面积 R=0.1/0: Rock wool k is about 0.040 W/(m*K) and 0.1 m thick: R per unit area = 0.1/0.04 = 2.5 (m2*K)/W, U = 0.4 W/(m2*K). Thickening to 200 mm gives R = 5 and U = 0.2, halving the heat transfer. Note: including internal and external surface resistances makes the total U slightly higher.
map.R 值越大越保温吗？: Does a Larger R Mean Better Insulation?
map.是。R 为热阻，越大阻热越好、U 越小；但受厚度、成本与空间限制，存在经济厚度。: Yes. R is thermal resistance: larger blocks heat better and U is smaller; but thickness, cost and space limit it, so an economic thickness exists.
map.为什么南方也要保温？: Why Insulate in the South as Well?
map.保温兼顾夏季隔热与冬季保温，降低空调/采暖负荷，且防潮防结露。: Insulation covers summer heat gain and winter heat retention, cutting air-conditioning and heating load while also blocking moisture and condensation.
